CustomField.description: The integer hour (0-23) when traffic is blocked.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: 0-24 format. The hour the Agent stops showing (e.g., 17 for 5:00 PM). Must be LATER than Start Hour — a window like 9 to 17 means the Agent shows 9am up to (not including) 5pm. Overnight windows that cross midnight are not supported.
CustomField.label: End Hour
